name: Minecraft Village (Muse)
description: A village builds itself block by block on a Muse worker: voxel structures from the kit, a cutting plane sweeping up, three camera moves, a pixel pay-off word and a caption. The Muse version; the cottage is another style.

cautions: The pack builds its own pixels: it asks the studio for no pictures. Until the asset model grows a "none" value, Studio's planner may still plan stills that this renderer ignores — the render is correct either way, the plan is just wasteful.

Textures are original block art from the Pixel-Perfection kit (CC BY-SA 4.0), vendored in render/assets/vendor; they are not Mojang's textures. Keep the attribution and the share-alike notice with the pack.
Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. No Mojang logo, character or texture is used.

Structures are cut from the kit's converted builds: a well, a farm, a house, a blacksmith, a church, a tavern, a library. The rotation is fixed by the style, so a script that asks for six shots gets six different buildings, not six copies.
One satisfying build per shot with one payoff word; a shot longer than the build needs holds the finished structure rather than cutting away.
